sources.description: Gaia Data Release 3 contributes precise source identity, astrometry, photometry, and motion measurements for the selected nearby-space inventory.
sources.mission_instrument: ESA Gaia spacecraft astrometry and photometry

sources.description: This catalog contributes Bayesian geometric and photogeometric distance estimates derived from Gaia EDR3 astrometry with an explicit Galactic prior.
sources.mission_instrument: Statistical distance inference from ESA Gaia EDR3 astrometry and photometry

sources.description: Gaia DR3 orbital and acceleration solutions for sources whose astrometry or spectra indicate that one-star motion is not an adequate model.
sources.mission_instrument: ESA Gaia spacecraft astrometry and radial-velocity spectroscopy

sources.description: NASA's curated archive contributes confirmed-planet identity, discovery context, and reference-specific and composite planet parameters.
sources.mission_instrument: Multi-mission exoplanet literature and archive compilation

sources.description: The official TOI/TIC evidence connects TESS targets and planet candidates to their host systems while preserving candidate, confirmed, false-positive, and false-alarm dispositions.
sources.mission_instrument: NASA TESS transit photometry and Exoplanet Follow-up Observing Program

sources.description: The Planetary Habitability Laboratory catalog contributes a published external assessment of potentially habitable worlds. It remains source evidence, not a Spacegate habitability verdict.
sources.mission_instrument: Literature compilation and published habitability metrics

sources.description: The Villanova catalog identifies and characterizes eclipsing binaries found in TESS photometry.
sources.mission_instrument: NASA TESS full-frame and short-cadence photometry

sources.description: The US Naval Observatory catalog preserves measured double-star pairs, component labels, relative positions, and observation history.
sources.mission_instrument: Published visual, speckle, interferometric, and other double-star observations

sources.description: The Multiple Star Catalog contributes reviewed hierarchical component relationships and source-native orbit context for complex stellar systems.
sources.mission_instrument: Literature compilation maintained by Andrei Tokovinin

sources.public_name: Sixth Catalog of Orbits of Visual Binary Stars
sources.description: ORB6 contributes published coherent visual-binary orbit solutions with their reference, grade, epoch, frame, and uncertainties.
sources.mission_instrument: US Naval Observatory compilation of resolved visual-binary astrometry

sources.description: SB9 contributes published spectroscopic-binary orbit solutions, component spectra, aliases, and bibliography.
sources.mission_instrument: Literature compilation of radial-velocity spectroscopy

sources.description: SBX contributes cross-catalog spectroscopic-system identity, hierarchy, component classifications, and orbit evidence.
sources.mission_instrument: Université libre de Bruxelles spectroscopic-binary database

sources.description: DEBCat contributes high-quality physical measurements for well-studied detached eclipsing binary components.
sources.mission_instrument: Reviewed literature compilation of detached eclipsing binaries

sources.description: SIMBAD contributes literature-linked object names, identifiers, object types, and selected bibliographic classifications.
sources.mission_instrument: CDS literature and catalog database

sources.public_name: IAU Working Group on Star Names
sources.description: The IAU WGSN catalog contributes internationally standardized proper star names and their cultural and bibliographic attribution.
sources.mission_instrument: International Astronomical Union nomenclature standard

sources.description: The ATNF catalog contributes published pulsar identity, timing, spin, distance, and binary context.
sources.mission_instrument: Multi-observatory pulsar timing and literature compilation

sources.description: The McGill catalog contributes reviewed magnetar identity, spin, activity, and observational context.
sources.mission_instrument: Multi-mission high-energy magnetar observations

sources.description: This catalog contributes white-dwarf candidates and fitted physical parameters tied to Gaia astrometry and photometry.
sources.mission_instrument: ESA Gaia EDR3 astrometry and photometry

sources.description: UltracoolSheet contributes literature-linked optical and infrared classifications for ultracool dwarfs.
sources.mission_instrument: Community literature compilation of ultracool-object observations

sources.description: APOGEE DR17 contributes high-resolution near-infrared stellar spectra, atmospheric parameters, radial velocities, and chemical abundances.
sources.mission_instrument: Sloan Digital Sky Survey APOGEE near-infrared spectrographs

sources.description: The extended-object compilation contributes identities, positions, types, dimensions, and aliases for clusters, nebulae, galaxies, and related deep-sky structures.
sources.mission_instrument: Open catalog compilation from published deep-sky observations

sources.description: This catalog contributes probability-bearing Gaia membership and physical context for Galactic open clusters.
sources.mission_instrument: ESA Gaia DR2 astrometry analyzed for co-moving stellar populations

sources.description: Targeted CatWISE2020 records contribute all-sky infrared positions, motions, and photometry for matched cool and high-proper-motion objects.
sources.mission_instrument: NASA WISE and NEOWISE multi-epoch infrared imaging

sources.description: NASA/IPAC IRSA serves the WISE and AllWISE infrared image products used by Spacegate's Infrared Sky View and targeted counterpart evidence.
sources.mission_instrument: NASA Wide-field Infrared Survey Explorer all-sky imaging in the W1-W4 bands

sources.description: JPL Horizons contributes pinned state vectors and osculating orbital elements for Solar System bodies under a documented frame, epoch, center, and query.
sources.mission_instrument: NASA JPL numerical ephemerides and observation-based orbit solutions

sources.description: AT-HYG contributes historical catalog cross-identifiers and bright-star compatibility evidence retained for public search and identity reconciliation.
sources.mission_instrument: Compilation of Hipparcos, Yale Bright Star, Gliese, and related catalogs
